Symbiomed
is
a specialized homecare provider focusing on respiratory, sleep, and oxygen diagnostic and treatment services
, rather than a manufacturer of consumer smartwatches or continuous glucose monitors.
Modern Health Wearables and Remote Monitoring
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Devices like the FreeStyle Libre or Sibionics insert a tiny filament under the skin to track interstitial sugar levels 24/7, sending real-time trends to a phone or compatible display.
Abbott
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Modern smartwatches track daily activity and heart rates, with select medical-grade models offering single-lead ECG and SpO₂ readings.
Amazon.in
Sleep Trackers:
Consumer rings, bands, and smartwatches analyze movement, heart rate variability, and blood oxygen to break down sleep stages.
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Systems that allow home users to capture vital metrics—such as blood pressure, glucose, or respiratory data—and securely transmit them to clinicians for ongoing chronic care management.
